english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or animal moving on hands and knees; with plants, it means trailing or spreading over a surface.

examples.english: The baby can crawl on the floor.
examples.jyutping: go3 jing1 ji4 hai2 dei6 haa6 paa4

english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for moving by climbing with the hands and feet, especially when no specific destination is stated.

examples.english: That dog really likes to climb around.
examples.jyutping: zek3 gau2 hou2 zung1 ji3 zau1 wai4 paa4
